limitations: Not an IPA, simulator or physical-device execution proof; no production storage or UI executed.

Signatures (sr25519), derived nonce material and encrypted JSON salt/nonce may vary across generation. Compare identities/scalars and verify signatures, rather than requiring byte-identical randomized values.
The old SECSigner context-lifetime bug is deliberately unpatched in this historical harness; recorded calls returned verified signatures, but this does not prove its memory safety.
The old scrypt C stray printf is deliberately unpatched; only public synthetic inputs enter this isolated process, and stdout is discarded when creating fixtures.
No current/audited crypto implementation was used to calculate historical expected values.
Coverage is the obtainable dependency families found in inspected local release tags; no 2.x tag was present in that inventory. This does not establish a full historical release inventory.
Extrinsic framing differs between FearlessUtils pins e6aaeb17 and 26dfc128; this host harness covers identity/signature/export algorithms, not full extrinsic building or network submission.
The 0.9 Iroha legacy subsystem is not invoked by the Substrate signing fixtures. Original 1.x Iroha key creation is covered independently using 0.2.6.
